spans.s:
अबेल Tatpur. (?) 1. m. (-लः) Denial or concealment of
knowledge (= अपह्नव).
2. f. (-ला) Chewed Betel. E. ? perhaps, अ neg. and
बेला; (the Śabdabheda portion of Viśva's Kosha mentions
the word amongst those which are to be written with a
ब्, not with a व्; it seems doubtful therefore whether the
masc. may be referred to अव and इला).
